local.title: Local Transport
local.description: Fast and secure delivery at the urban and suburban level. Maximum flexibility for your urgent runs.
local.long_description: Our local transport service is designed to meet the speed and reliability requirements of businesses and individuals in urban environments. Whether for urgent envelopes or bulky goods, we ensure a seamless delivery.

meta.title: Local Transport - ORANOS TRANS | Fast Urban Delivery
meta.description: Need a reliable local transporter? ORANOS TRANS handles your urban deliveries with speed and expertise.

road.title: Road Transport
road.description: Flexible solutions for national and regional road transport. A modern fleet for all your goods.
road.long_description: ORANOS TRANS offers tailored road transport solutions, covering the entire national and regional territory. We manage all types of loads, from Less than Truckload (LTL) to Full Truckload (FTL).

meta.title: Road Transport - ORANOS TRANS | National & Regional Freight
meta.description: Expert in national road transport. ORANOS TRANS guarantees the safety and punctuality of your road shipments.

sea.title: Sea Transport
sea.description: Import/Export Cargo via international sea routes. Competitive FCL and LCL solutions.
sea.long_description: Thanks to our network of port partners, we offer global sea transport solutions. We manage the entire logistics chain, from stuffing to customs formalities.

meta.title: Sea Transport - ORANOS TRANS | Global Import/Export
meta.description: Optimize your sea transport costs with ORANOS TRANS. Expert in port logistics and international freight.

air.title: Air Transport
air.description: Fast air freight services for your urgent goods. Worldwide connection in record time.
air.long_description: For your most urgent and precious shipments, our air transport service guarantees unparalleled speed. We collaborate with major airlines to secure your cargo space.

meta.title: Air Transport - ORANOS TRANS | Urgent Freight Solution
meta.description: Absolute speed. ORANOS TRANS transports your goods by air worldwide with premium service.
